description: This Java class 'Debug' provides a configurable logging wrapper for the OFBiz framework, managing different log levels and output based on properties.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A final class providing static methods for logging at various levels with configuration options.

methods.name: getLevelFromString
methods.description: Returns the integer level corresponding to a string name, or null if not found.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified level, optional throwable, module, calling class, and parameters.

methods.name: isOn
methods.description: Checks if a given log level is enabled based on cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the cache for a specific log level to on or off.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves whether a specific log level is enabled.
